events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Serene Waters Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A public Hempz Serene Waters body-care pop-up outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square with a relaxation experience, beverage truck, product discovery and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free public pop-up access; current NYC event coverage promotes complimentary magnesium iced tea. Separate meet-and-greet gifts/swag may be tied to purchase and capacity.
events.caveats: The general outdoor pop-up is listed as open to the public from 12:30–6:30 PM. The separate Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet runs 4–6:30 PM, requires an Eventbrite RSVP, is limited to 80 virtual tickets, and promotes exclusive gifts with purchase. Do not imply that the meet-and-greet RSVP is required for the general public pop-up.
events.practical_notes: General activation is outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square. For the Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet, guests must show Eventbrite confirmation and may line up no earlier than one hour before the 4 PM start.

events.what_it_is: A one-day public NYFW activation launching BuzzBallz's limited-edition BuzzBagz handbag collection in the U.S.
events.what_is_free: Public walk-in access; BuzzBagz themselves are sold for $100 while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on September 15 at 45 Lispenard Street beginning at 3 PM and describe the activation as public. The promotion is explicitly for fans 21+. BuzzBagz cost $100 and are while supplies last; admission itself is not described as ticketed.
events.practical_notes: 21+ activation. Arrive near the 3 PM start if purchasing a limited-edition BuzzBagz is the priority.

events.address: CityPickle Times Square, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A Perk pickleball afternoon at CityPickle Times Square with games, giveaways, food and drinks; attendees can bring a team, a friend or join solo.
events.what_is_free: Free RSVP admission with games, giveaways, food and drinks promoted by the organizer.
events.caveats: Perk's current social post and NYC event listing agree on September 16, 11:30 AM–2 PM at CityPickle Times Square and advertise free sign-up. Perk also says only a handful of places remain, so availability may tighten quickly.
events.practical_notes: RSVP before traveling because the organizer says capacity is limited and only a handful of places remain.

events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-day Medik8 skincare pop-up at Sephora SoHo with free samples, personalized skincare consultations and giveaways. Ariana Madix is scheduled for a separate qualifying meet-and-greet on September 16.
events.what_is_free: Free samples and personalized skincare consultations; additional giveaways are promoted. The Ariana Madix meet-and-greet requires a qualifying purchase and wristband.
events.caveats: Medik8's official page confirms Sephora SoHo on September 16 from 12–8 PM and September 17 from 11 AM–7 PM with RSVP links, free samples and consultations. On September 16 the public pop-up portion is described as 12–5:30 PM, followed by Ariana Madix 6–8 PM. The meet-and-greet is limited to the first 150 eligible customers who buy 2+ full-sized Medik8 products and receive a wristband; a Partiful RSVP does not guarantee meet-and-greet entry.
events.practical_notes: For general pop-up access, use the official Medik8 RSVP. If trying to meet Ariana Madix on September 16, the line opens 11:30 AM and the qualifying-purchase/wristband terms apply separately.
